scope: Real NarrativeQA official book-disjoint subset: Dorian Gray validation, Persuasion test; no summary is indexed

protocol.selection_metric: Mean per-question maximum gold answer content-token recall in any top-5 passage; weak lexical evidence proxy, not QA accuracy
protocol.limitations: NarrativeQA questions were written from story summaries, not passage-level evidence. Answers can be paraphrased or absent from the edition. Literal answer presence and token recall do not establish relevance, reasoning, complete answers, or thematic understanding. Two books is a narrow subset.
